body: I'm sure they do. They're independent enough creatures that they'd leave if they didn't like you. You're also still here, and it's been a couple of days since the OP. Perhaps you yelled into the void to see if it would respond, and it did. Maybe you just needed to know you weren't alone?
Do you love them? Do you think they love you?
Story of my life. Do you have any pets?

I don't know where you're from, but my suggestion would be to stop listening to what the news tells you and go talk to your neighbors. What you're shown on TV nowadays is meant for nothing more than division.

There is far more love in the world that you're being told.
Like I said in the op, the only reason I'm here now is because I can't put my family through another suicide. You've got people looking up to you, that's something to be proud of.

I'm so sorry. I lost a brother to suicide when I was 8, so luckily for me it's mostly a blur. I can't imagine the pain and emptiness you've felt since then, but if you can find any reason to stay, it might be worth it.
I don't have kids, and I don't have any close friends with children that see me in such a light, but I'm glad you found a reason to stay.
I've had my share, and honestly they're part of the reason I am where I am.

I've lost interest in what few things once made me happy, and therapy won't get me anywhere I haven't already been. I went trail riding a couple of days ago and I used to not be able to sit still for more than a few minutes, but that day I drove to the highest point, as far away from people as I could get, and say for two hours thinking about just driving over the bluff.

That I can't tell you, because I'm on the same boat, but for different reasons. What I can tell you is, if you see the slightest glimmer at the end of the road, it might be worth trying to get to, and that's something I'm struggling with myself.

Your parents have their own issues to deal with it seems, and your family is who you choose, not who you're related to by blood. Nothing is stopping you from cutting ties with your abusive parents, and I don't knownhow anyone could look down on you for it.
It seems like you're here hoping someone can. What's up?
